sections.heading: Payment
items: A 50% upfront payment is required before work begins.
The remaining 50% is paid after the agreed work is completed.
For small commissions, payment is split into 50% upfront and 50% after completion.
For larger or ongoing projects, work can be handled per task or per month.

sections.heading: Project Requirements
items: You must provide all assets required for the requested work.
You must provide a Game Design Document before development begins.
The Game Design Document should clearly describe every system that is expected to be developed.

sections.heading: Game Design Document
text: The provided Game Design Document should contain enough information for development to begin without requiring major assumptions about how the requested systems should work.

sections.heading: Development Structure
items: Work can be completed per task for smaller commissions.
Work can be completed monthly for larger or ongoing projects.
The payment structure will be agreed upon before development begins.
Large projects may be separated into milestones or individual tasks.

sections.heading: Scope Changes
items: Requests outside the agreed scope may require additional payment.
Major changes to already completed systems may be treated as new work.
Additional assets or requirements should be provided before the related work begins.

sections.heading: Communication
text: Clear communication is expected throughout development. Requirements, assets, design documents, and other relevant information should be provided before the corresponding work begins.
